This story was originally recorded by Shigeru Tsuchida in February 1969. The speaker is Angaiana Paepuli. The original transcription and analysis are published in Tsuchida, Shigeru (2003). Kanakanavu Texts (Austronesian Formosan). Osaka: Osaka Gakuin University (Endangered Languages of the Pacific Rim Publications Series A3-014).

S.FORM: tee-pa ku puumuamuarʉ sua ni-murucang taamu miena.
S.PHON: teepa ku puumuamua[r|ɾ]ɨ sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ taamu miena
S.FORM: teepa ku puumuamuarʉ sua nimurucang taamu miena.
S.PHON: teepa ku puumuamua[r|ɾ]ɨ sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ taamu miena
S.TRANSL: I will be talking about the one married to a Tamu long ago.
我要講以前一個人嫁給百步蛇的故事。

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); taamu: hundred-space snake

S.TRANSL: I'm going to talk about the one who married taamu long time ago.

S.FORM: timana-u sua isi ikamu tati'ing kavangvang manasii tavara'ʉ kamu.
S.PHON: timanau sua isi ikamu tatiʔiŋ kavaŋvaŋ manasii tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ kamu
S.FORM: timanau sua isi ikamu tati'ing kavangvang manasii tavara'ʉ kamu.
S.PHON: timanau sua isi ikamu tatiʔiŋ kavaŋvaŋ manasii tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ kamu
S.TRANSL: Listen to this, all you little ones, so that you know.
孩子們要聽啊！所以你們才會知道。
Listen to this, you all children, so that you may know.

FORM.notes: source writes "ikam(u)"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("i:kam(u)"), which appears to mark them as unclear
source writes "kam(u)"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("kam(u)"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: sua ni-murucang taamu miena ia ni-aranai kani aracin sua 'uusu.
S.PHON: sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ taamu miena ia nia[r|ɾ]anai kani a[r|ɾ]aʦin sua ʔuusu
S.FORM: sua nimurucang taamu miena ia niaranai kani aracin sua 'uusu.
S.PHON: sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ taamu miena ia nia[r|ɾ]anai kani a[r|ɾ]aʦin sua ʔuusu
S.TRANSL: As for the one married to a Tamu, she was from far away, that 'Usu.
嫁給百步蛇的這個人來自遙遠的地方。
The one who married Tamu, 'Usu came from far.

S.FORM: murucang sua ni-aravanga in ia kakʉkʉna kani.
S.PHON: mu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ sua nia[r|ɾ]avaŋa in ia kakɨkɨna kani
S.FORM: murucang sua niaravanga in ia kakʉkʉna kani.
S.PHON: mu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ sua nia[r|ɾ]avaŋa in ia kakɨkɨna kani
S.TRANSL: As for the family to marry in, they made food.
The family which took wife prepared for wedding.

S.FORM: sua ni-murucang ia maica kan cacaan.
S.PHON: sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ ia maiʦa kan ʦaʦaan
S.FORM: sua nimurucang ia maica kan cacaan.
S.PHON: sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ ia maiʦa kan ʦaʦaan
S.TRANSL: As for the one who married, she walked by (on the street).
結婚的人走在道路上。

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); the one who married = 'Usu

S.TRANSL: The one who married passed on the way.

S.FORM: 'una kan puukarikari tapoo'i caarei kia 'uusu ni-murucang taamu misa kani!
S.PHON: ʔuna kan puuka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i tapooʔi ʦaa[r|ɾ]ei kia ʔuusu nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ taamu misa kani
S.FORM: 'una kan puukarikari tapoo'i caarei kia 'uusu nimurucang taamu misa kani!
S.PHON: ʔuna kan puuka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i tapooʔi ʦaa[r|ɾ]ei kia ʔuusu nimu[r|ɾ]uʦaŋ taamu misa kani
S.TRANSL: There was a Tapo'i-bird saying (imitating her): What a pity! I am married to a Tamu!
Taapo'i說：真是可惜我要嫁給Tamu！

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); taapuu'ai: a type of bird

S.TRANSL: There was a taapuu'ai chirping, "What a pity I, 'Usu, am! I got married to Tamu!"

S.FORM: marivari kan sua puukarikari kan sua nanakʉ 'uusu nei sua iisua ravai misa kani?
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i kan sua puuka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i kan sua nanakɨ ʔuusu nei sua iisua [r|ɾ]avai misa kani
S.FORM: marivari kan sua puukarikari kan sua nanakʉ 'uusu nei sua iisua ravai misa kani?
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i kan sua puuka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i kan sua nanakɨ ʔuusu nei sua iisua [r|ɾ]avai misa kani
S.TRANSL: The woman 'Usu said: What is that, friend?
這個女人Usu說：這是什麼啊朋友？
The woman, 'Usu, said, "What's that, friend?"

S.FORM: akuni 'urunam-ei masiraru makasi tapoo'i sien misa kani.
S.PHON: akuni ʔu[r|ɾ]unamei masi[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u makasi tapooʔi sien misa kani
S.FORM: akuni 'urunamei masiraru makasi tapoo'i sien misa kani.
S.PHON: akuni ʔu[r|ɾ]unamei masi[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u makasi tapooʔi sien misa kani
S.TRANSL: Don't worry, those Tapo'i-birds are like that here, she said.
她說：別擔心，taapo'i鳥兒總是這樣。
"Don't worry, for taapuu'ai-bird here does always like this," said she.

S.FORM: mucaan kan cu makaasi tanasa sua tia ta'esi'a ucang-in.
S.PHON: muʦaan kan ʦu makaasi tanasa sua tia taʔesiʔa uʦaŋin
S.FORM: mucaan kan cu makaasi tanasa sua tia ta'esi'a ucangin.
S.PHON: muʦaan kan ʦu makaasi tanasa sua tia taʔesiʔa uʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: She went towards the house where her husband would be.
她去了她先生可能待的房子。
She went to the house where her husband would be.

S.FORM: apa-kʉʉn-ei kan sua cau-in sua 'uusu.
S.PHON: apakɨɨnei kan sua ʦauin sua ʔuusu
S.FORM: apakʉʉnei kan sua cauin sua 'uusu.
S.PHON: apakɨɨnei kan sua ʦauin sua ʔuusu
S.TRANSL: His people let 'Usu eat.
先生的家人們讓Usu吃。
Members of his family let 'Usu eat.

S.FORM: kuvʉʉcʉrʉk-a misa kan kavangvang sua cau-ini cau pining.
S.PHON: kuvɨɨʦɨ[r|ɾ]ɨka misa kan kavaŋvaŋ sua ʦauini ʦau piniŋ
S.FORM: kuvʉʉcʉrʉka misa kan kavangvang sua cauini cau pining.
S.PHON: kuvɨɨʦɨ[r|ɾ]ɨka misa kan kavaŋvaŋ sua ʦauini ʦau piniŋ
S.TRANSL: "Eat until you are full", said all his people, the houshold members.
家人們說：你就吃到飽吧！
"Eat full," said all the members of his family.

S.FORM: taravaavari kan sua 'uusu neinei tia ra'ʉv aku makasi misa kani?
S.PHON: ta[r|ɾ]avaava[r|ɾ]i kan sua ʔuusu neinei tia [r|ɾ]aʔɨv aku makasi misa kani
S.FORM: taravaavari kan sua 'uusu neinei tia ra'ʉv aku makasi misa kani?
S.PHON: ta[r|ɾ]avaava[r|ɾ]i kan sua ʔuusu neinei tia [r|ɾ]aʔɨv aku makasi misa kani
S.TRANSL: 'Usu looked everywhere and said: "Which one is going to be my partner?"
Usu看了看四周說：我未來的先生在哪裡呢？
'Usu looked around, and said like this, "Where is the one who is going to be my husband?"

FORM.notes: source writes "ak(u)"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("ak(u)"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: akia kan cu tavara in tia ra'ʉv-in.
S.PHON: akia kan ʦu tava[r|ɾ]a in tia [r|ɾ]aʔɨvin
S.FORM: akia kan cu tavara in tia ra'ʉvin.
S.PHON: akia kan ʦu tava[r|ɾ]a in tia [r|ɾ]aʔɨvin
S.TRANSL: She did not know her future partner.
她無法認出未來的先生。
She could not recognize her would-be husband.

S.FORM: masiravarava kan sua 'esi tavanvana.
S.PHON: masi[r|ɾ]ava[r|ɾ]ava kan sua ʔesi tavanvana
S.FORM: masiravarava kan sua 'esi tavanvana.
S.PHON: masi[r|ɾ]ava[r|ɾ]ava kan sua ʔesi tavanvana
S.TRANSL: The one who was at the corner spoke last.
房間一角最後說話的人。
The one who was at the corner of the room spoke last.

S.FORM: 'esi kan t<in>akituumura taamu sua viiluha.
S.PHON: ʔesi kan tinakituumu[r|ɾ]a taamu sua vii*uha
S.FORM: 'esi kan tinakituumura taamu sua viiluha.
S.PHON: ʔesi kan tinakituumu[r|ɾ]a taamu sua vii*uha
S.TRANSL: There was a Tamu curling around in a flat basket.
Tamu把自己纏繞在平坦的籃子上。
There was a Tamu coiling itself in a flat basket.

S.FORM: kuvʉʉcʉrʉk-a 'uusu misa kani.
S.PHON: kuvɨɨʦɨ[r|ɾ]ɨka ʔuusu misa kani
S.FORM: kuvʉʉcʉrʉka 'uusu misa kani.
S.PHON: kuvɨɨʦɨ[r|ɾ]ɨka ʔuusu misa kani
S.TRANSL: "Eat until you are full, 'Usu!" he said.
她說：＂你就吃到飽吧！Usu＂。
"Eat until satiated, 'Usu," said he.

S.FORM: aranei kan cu 'inia koo kan cu maamia k<um>ʉnʉ.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei kan ʦu ʔinia koo kan ʦu maamia kumɨnɨ
S.FORM: aranei kan cu 'inia koo kan cu maamia kumʉnʉ.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei kan ʦu ʔinia koo kan ʦu maamia kumɨnɨ
S.TRANSL: Since then she just did not eat.
從此之後，她就不再吃了。
Since that time, she did not just eat.

S.FORM: tee kan cu 'acan ceinana mataringʉntʉna kan.
S.PHON: tee kan ʦu ʔaʦan ʦeinana mata[r|ɾ]iŋɨntɨna kan
S.FORM: tee kan cu 'acan ceinana mataringʉntʉna kan.
S.PHON: tee kan ʦu ʔaʦan ʦeinana mata[r|ɾ]iŋɨntɨna kan
S.TRANSL: In one year she wll become emaciated.
一年後她會骨瘦如柴。
In one year she became skinny.

S.FORM: mapainpin kan cu 'inia sua cau-in.
S.PHON: mapainpin kan ʦu ʔinia sua ʦauin
S.FORM: mapainpin kan cu 'inia sua cauin.
S.PHON: mapainpin kan ʦu ʔinia sua ʦauin
S.TRANSL: His people were worried about her.
家人們很擔心她。
The members of her family nervously worried about her.

S.FORM: makariikari kan sua cau-in mata ucang-in.
S.PHON: maka[r|ɾ]iika[r|ɾ]i kan sua ʦauin mata uʦaŋin
S.FORM: makariikari kan sua cauin mata ucangin.
S.PHON: maka[r|ɾ]iika[r|ɾ]i kan sua ʦauin mata uʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: His people discussed with her husband.
家人們和她的先生討論。
Her family members consulted with her husband.

S.FORM: tee mita kuusa paaka-'ʉn naan si makasi?
S.PHON: tee mita kuusa paakaʔɨn naan si makasi
S.FORM: tee mita kuusa paaka'ʉn naan si makasi?
S.PHON: tee mita kuusa paakaʔɨn naan si makasi
S.TRANSL: "How on earth can we handle this if it stays like this?"
我們到底該怎麼處理這個情況？
"How on the earth should we do if it's like this?

S.FORM: k<um>irim-a pa tia cʉpʉng su tee mita paaka-'ʉn naanu si makasi misa kani.
S.PHON: kumi[r|ɾ]ima pa tia ʦɨpɨŋ su tee mita paakaʔɨn naanu si makasi misa kani
S.FORM: kumirima pa tia cʉpʉng su tee mita paaka'ʉn naanu si makasi misa kani.
S.PHON: kumi[r|ɾ]ima pa tia ʦɨpɨŋ su tee mita paakaʔɨn naanu si makasi misa kani
S.TRANSL: "Search for a solution, what should we do if it is like this?" they said.
他們說：＂找個解決方法吧！＂
"Let us see what you think, what should we do if it's like this?" they said.

S.FORM: arivic-ei kan sua anei-in sua 'uusu marikusa 'umoo'uma.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]iviʦei kan sua aneiin sua ʔuusu ma[r|ɾ]ikusa ʔumooʔuma
S.FORM: arivicei kan sua aneiin sua 'uusu marikusa 'umoo'uma.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]iviʦei kan sua aneiin sua ʔuusu ma[r|ɾ]ikusa ʔumooʔuma
S.TRANSL: A woman with the same name as 'Usu took 'Usu to the field.
一個也叫Usu的女人帶她到田地去。
A woman with the same name as her took 'Usu to the fields.

S.FORM: 'acu'ava kani cu sua taamu mukusa saana napako'ica na cacaan nakʉnakʉ caacan napako'ica.
S.PHON: ʔaʦuʔava kani ʦu sua taamu mukusa saana napakoʔiʦa na ʦaʦaan nakɨnakɨ ʦaaʦan napakoʔiʦa
S.FORM: 'acu'ava kani cu sua taamu mukusa saana napako'ica na cacaan nakʉnakʉ caacan napako'ica.
S.PHON: ʔaʦuʔava kani ʦu sua taamu mukusa saana napakoʔiʦa na ʦaʦaan nakɨnakɨ ʦaaʦan napakoʔiʦa
S.TRANSL: The Tamu must have gone to the foot of the waterfall Napako'ica.
Tamu一定要去一個叫Napaka'uica的瀑布。
Tamu must have gone down to the waterfalls called Napaka'uica.

S.FORM: pa-siki kusa 'inia sua navung-in.
S.PHON: pasiki kusa ʔinia sua navuŋin
S.FORM: pasiki kusa 'inia sua navungin.
S.PHON: pasiki kusa ʔinia sua navuŋin
S.TRANSL: He let his head drop into it.
他讓他的頭浸在瀑布裡。
He let water fall upon his head.

S.FORM: pa-siki-tʉvʉ sua naa-rapatʉ taamu matairi kan.
S.PHON: pasikitɨvɨ sua naa[r|ɾ]apatɨ taamu matai[r|ɾ]i kan
S.FORM: pasikitʉvʉ sua naarapatʉ taamu matairi kan.
S.PHON: pasikitɨvɨ sua naa[r|ɾ]apatɨ taamu matai[r|ɾ]i kan
S.TRANSL: He left it in there for a while (and then) his skin changed into something new.
他讓頭浸在瀑布裡一陣子後，他的皮膚變成新的。
Tamu molted by letting water fall upon its head.

S.FORM: cau kan ni-maru-manʉng.
S.PHON: ʦau kan nima[r|ɾ]umanɨŋ
S.FORM: cau kan nimarumanʉng.
S.PHON: ʦau kan nima[r|ɾ]umanɨŋ
S.TRANSL: He became a handsome man.
他變成一個英俊的男子。
He became a fine built man.

S.FORM: po'i kan cu miaruruvana aranei 'umoo'uma makasi kan cacaan.
S.PHON: poʔi kan ʦu mia[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]uvana a[r|ɾ]anei ʔumooʔuma makasi kan ʦaʦaan
S.FORM: po'i kan cu miaruruvana aranei 'umoo'uma makasi kan cacaan.
S.PHON: poʔi kan ʦu mia[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]uvana a[r|ɾ]anei ʔumooʔuma makasi kan ʦaʦaan
S.TRANSL: They ('Usu and her namesake) returning from the field that night, went on their way.
他們（Usu和與她同名的女子）當晚回到田地裡的路上。

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); they = 'Usu and her friend

S.TRANSL: They came back from the fields in the evening on the way.

S.FORM: puusuaraar-a tatupurua saana ravai kisoe kan kei sua anei-in 'uusu.
S.PHON: puusua[r|ɾ]aa[r|ɾ]a tatupu[r|ɾ]ua saana [r|ɾ]avai kisoe kan kei sua aneiin ʔuusu
S.FORM: puusuaraara tatupurua saana ravai kisoe kan kei sua aneiin 'uusu.
S.PHON: puusua[r|ɾ]aa[r|ɾ]a tatupu[r|ɾ]ua saana [r|ɾ]avai kisoe kan kei sua aneiin ʔuusu
S.TRANSL: "Look around the place to sit over there friend" said 'Usu to her namesake.
Usu對與她同名的女子說：＂看看四周然後坐下吧朋友！＂
"Look around the resting place over there, friend!" said 'Usu to her friend with the same name.

S.FORM: cau makananu misa kani sua anei-in.
S.PHON: ʦau makananu misa kani sua aneiin
S.FORM: cau makananu misa kani sua aneiin.
S.PHON: ʦau makananu misa kani sua aneiin
S.TRANSL: "What kind of man (is he)?", the namesake said.
與Usu同名的女子說：＂他是一個怎麼樣的人呢？＂
"What kind of man?" said her friend.

S.FORM: avara'e maamia sua cau kisoʉn kan anei-in.
S.PHON: ava[r|ɾ]aʔe maamia sua ʦau kisoɨn kan aneiin
S.FORM: avara'e maamia sua cau kisoʉn kan aneiin.
S.PHON: ava[r|ɾ]aʔe maamia sua ʦau kisoɨn kan aneiin
S.TRANSL: "Whatever (man he might be), he is just a man (which is good)", the namesake said.
她又說：＂不管他是怎麼樣的人，一定是個好人吧！＂
"Whatever man he may be, it is all right because he is a man," said the friend.

S.FORM: aracan kan cu tatupurua tarakusa kan 'inia.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʦan kan ʦu tatupu[r|ɾ]ua ta[r|ɾ]akusa kan ʔinia
S.FORM: aracan kan cu tatupurua tarakusa kan 'inia.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʦan kan ʦu tatupu[r|ɾ]ua ta[r|ɾ]akusa kan ʔinia
S.TRANSL: They came near the sitting place, she looked at him.
他們來到靠近坐的地方，她看著他。
They came near the resting place. She looked at him.

S.FORM: 'esi kani t<in>puru in 'inia sua cau ni-runingasʉ kan ni-matikuru kan kanasiang.
S.PHON: ʔesi kani tinpu[r|ɾ]u in ʔinia sua ʦau ni[r|ɾ]uniŋasɨ kan nimatiku[r|ɾ]u kan kanasiaŋ
S.FORM: 'esi kani tinpuru in 'inia sua cau niruningasʉ kan nimatikuru kan kanasiang.
S.PHON: ʔesi kani tinpu[r|ɾ]u in ʔinia sua ʦau ni[r|ɾ]uniŋasɨ kan nimatiku[r|ɾ]u kan kanasiaŋ
S.TRANSL: There was a man, sitting there dressed up in his formal Kanakanavu garment.
有一個男子坐在那裏穿著以前Kanakanavu的服裝 。

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); red garment: formal dress

S.TRANSL: A man was there dressed in his best, dressed in the red garment.

S.FORM: makitara'una kan 'inia.
S.PHON: makita[r|ɾ]aʔuna kan ʔinia
S.FORM: makitara'una kan 'inia.
S.PHON: makita[r|ɾ]aʔuna kan ʔinia

TRANSL.notes: author suggests that this might mean she came closer (source: "(she came closer?)")

S.TRANSL: She was (already) there.
她已經在那裏了。
She stepped up on the resting place.

S.FORM: masisurumu kani nai vua'i ikua kakiicu su 'uusu misa kani!
S.PHON: masisu[r|ɾ]umu kani nai vuaʔi ikua kakiiʦu su ʔuusu misa kani
S.FORM: masisurumu kani nai vua'i ikua kakiicu su 'uusu misa kani!
S.PHON: masisu[r|ɾ]umu kani nai vuaʔi ikua kakiiʦu su ʔuusu misa kani
S.TRANSL: Unnoticed by others, he said: "Hi, give me your netbag, 'Usu!"

TRANSL.notes: 網袋 (what it refers to is not clear to me)

S.TRANSL: 他一直講話，沒有與她商量。
He spoke to her unconsciously, "Hi, give me your net-bag, 'Usu!"

S.FORM: mua kan ra'ʉv-in sua isua.
S.PHON: mua kan [r|ɾ]aʔɨvin sua isua
S.FORM: mua kan ra'ʉvin sua isua.
S.PHON: mua kan [r|ɾ]aʔɨvin sua isua
S.TRANSL: Certainly this was her husband.
她走到那邊，哇！
Most likely that was her husband.

S.FORM: makai kan 'inia arakicacʉ mamanʉng cu cʉpʉng-in.
S.PHON: makai kan ʔinia a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦɨ mamanɨŋ ʦu ʦɨpɨŋin
S.FORM: makai kan 'inia arakicacʉ mamanʉng cu cʉpʉngin.
S.PHON: makai kan ʔinia a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦɨ mamanɨŋ ʦu ʦɨpɨŋin
S.TRANSL: She was surprised but in a good mood.
她不難過了。
She looked surprised, but she was happy.

S.FORM: aranei cu nesa makasi kan cu tanasa.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei ʦu nesa makasi kan ʦu tanasa
S.FORM: aranei cu nesa makasi kan cu tanasa.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei ʦu nesa makasi kan ʦu tanasa
S.TRANSL: Then she went home.
她回到家。
Then she came home.

S.TRANSL: She looked in the flat basket first.
她先看villua。
She looked at the flat basket first.

S.FORM: akia kan cu 'inia sua taamu.
S.PHON: akia kan ʦu ʔinia sua taamu
S.FORM: akia kan cu 'inia sua taamu.
S.PHON: akia kan ʦu ʔinia sua taamu
S.TRANSL: The Tamu was not there.
百步蛇已經不在了。
The Tamu was not there.

S.FORM: nguai ava-ai misa kani pacʉpʉcʉpʉng.
S.PHON: ŋuai avaai misa kani paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋ
S.FORM: nguai avaai misa kani pacʉpʉcʉpʉng.
S.PHON: ŋuai avaai misa kani paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋ
S.TRANSL: "That one is him maybe", she thought.
她想：＂可能就是他了。＂
'That may be he," she thought.

S.FORM: aranei cu 'inia koo kan cu kei paratʉkʉnei sua saronei.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anei ʦu ʔinia koo kan ʦu kei pa[r|ɾ]atɨkɨnei sua sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.TRANSL: From that time on, she did not let the man leave.
從那時開始，她的先生就不讓她離開。
Since then she did not allow the man leave from her.

S.FORM: ka'aan kan cu tavara'ʉ aracakan.
S.PHON: kaʔaan kan ʦu tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ a[r|ɾ]aʦakan
S.FORM: ka'aan kan cu tavara'ʉ aracakan.
S.PHON: kaʔaan kan ʦu tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ a[r|ɾ]aʦakan
S.TRANSL: He did not know anymore how to hunt.
從那時候開始，他不能去打獵。
He could not go hunting (since his wife did not leave him).

S.FORM: muarangatʉ kan cu 'inia sua marakʉrakʉrapʉ tia ara-ini sii ka'an cu paraurumʉn nanakʉ sua saronei.
S.PHON: mua[r|ɾ]aŋatɨ kan ʦu ʔinia sua ma[r|ɾ]akɨ[r|ɾ]akɨ[r|ɾ]apɨ tia a[r|ɾ]aini sii kaʔan ʦu pa[r|ɾ]au[r|ɾ]umɨn nanakɨ sua sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.FORM: muarangatʉ kan cu 'inia sua marakʉrakʉrapʉ tia araini sii ka'an cu paraurumʉn nanakʉ sua saronei.
S.PHON: mua[r|ɾ]aŋatɨ kan ʦu ʔinia sua ma[r|ɾ]akɨ[r|ɾ]akɨ[r|ɾ]apɨ tia a[r|ɾ]aini sii kaʔan ʦu pa[r|ɾ]au[r|ɾ]umɨn nanakɨ sua sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.TRANSL: The animals came to them by themselves because the woman did not let the man leave.
從此之後，動物們自己到他們的家裡因為他的先生不再去打獵了。
The animals came to him by themselves which he took because the woman did not let her husband leave.
